title: paperclip agent API key endpoints cross-tenant IDOR
summary: Agent API key routes fail to enforce tenant isolation, allowing cross-tenant key read/modify (GHSA-47wq-cj9q-wpmp).

threat_model.attacker: authenticated tenant user guessing peer agent ids
threat_model.boundary: HTTP agent API key routes → multi-tenant store
threat_model.impact: unauthorized cross-tenant credential leak and key overwrite via IDOR

patch_sketch: Scope agent lookups by tenant_id; deny cross-tenant ids.
